name: More Than Meets the Eye
source:
More Than Meets the Eye is a visual novel about the adventure of a guy and two girls.  It seems like a peaceful funny life but it is everything really what it seems at first?

[Edited from [url=https://boghdan96.itch.io/more-than-meets-the-eye-version-003] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《超越眼睛》是一部关于一个男孩和两个女孩冒险的视觉小说。看似平静有趣的生活，但一切真的如表面所见吗？

[编辑自[url=https://boghdan96.itch.io/more-than-meets-the-eye-version-003] itch.io[/url]]
